about: Every key of the 12 vendor Punjabi keyboards (C:/Shree-Lipi nxt/*.PUN, loaded from their original paths) answered by S8PunU64.dll (TutorGetMappedCodeW, Unicode) and S8Pun764.dll (TutorGetMappedCode, Shree-Lipi 7 raw bytes; the 4/5/6 fonts draw the same bytes, ₹ = 3C exists in 7 only). Two capture runs (capvo/, capvo-b/) were byte-identical, and each run asked every key twice (#stable 1). layer 0 = printed keyboard (normal and shift are different ASCII keys), layer 1 = Ctrl+Space, layer 2 = the composer raw code layer (key char = internal code; NOT the Ctrl+Shift+1 symbol layer, which the tutor does not expose). Per key: codes = the internal codes the key holds (a conjunct slot expanded, typed order), uHex/u = the Unicode composer answer raw / without its carrier, b7 = the 7 composer bytes. u null = no answer or a placeholder; b7 "07 xx" = the 7 composer shows a lone sign on byte 07 (no font has 07).

ctrlShift1.source: the vendor charts (CHM "Special Keys", the same in all 13 Punjabi charts: assets/config/layouts/pun-*.json "symbols") + the composers' answers for the internal code of each character (single-code probes)
